texts.en:
We have discovered some £minor_artifacts£ Minor Artifacts. These are an esoteric resource - a catch-all term for strange items which we do not understand and indeed may be inexplicable.

These can be used to enact a variety of decisions.

To interact with Minor Artifacts;

£dot_green£ Click the Discoveries button on the left side bar
£dot_green£ Select the Collection tab or press C
